_meta.description: Verbatim CME contract-spec transcription for the pooled futures: trading hours, termination rule, listed-contract rule and contract unit exactly as published on each product's official contractSpecs page. Machine-generated by scripts/fetch_cme_specs.py from the raw HTML stored under data/cme_specs/; scripts/verify.py re-extracts from that HTML and fails on any divergence. The simulation engine does not drop sessions from these hours. Dated roll calendars are not transcribed here.
